subject: Cortexa Dedicated renewal — capacity forecast & burst playbook
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@cortexa.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Cortexa Dedicated renewal — capacity forecast & burst playbook

Hi Maria,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our discussion, I put together a short forecast and a recommended burst/commit playbook so Cortexa can avoid throttling during the next two quarters. Key points in the attached sheet: expected token growth by service, estimated sustained GPUs for 99th percentile, and two burst tranche options (1.5x and 2.0x) for handling marketing/seasonal spikes.

Quick asks from our side so we can finalize numbers:
- Can you confirm the 90-day rolling peak from your embedding pipeline (we saw ~320 TFLOP-hrs/day in the sample you shared)?
- Any plans to materially increase real-time chat concurrency (outside of the batch embedding jobs) over the next 90 days?

I attached an initial sizing workbook (Cortexa_Renewal_QoS_Sizing.xlsx) and included a notes tab with assumptions. If you prefer, I can schedule a 30-min squeeze session with Ben to run the model against your logs.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
connor@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Cortexa_Renewal_QoS_Sizing.xlsx (spreadsheet, 56KB)

From: Maria Alvarez <maria@cortexa.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Cortexa Dedicated renewal — capacity forecast & burst playbook

Connor —

Appreciate the workbook. Two quick updates from our side:
1) We just finished a marketing push last week and saw an unexpected sustained uplift in inference qps for our question-answering endpoint — roughly +65% week-over-week for 10 days. The attached export includes the last 30 days of peak/median usage.
2) We plan to launch a small personalization feature next month that will increase seq lengths and KV cache pressure, so latency-sensitive requests will be heavier.

Given that, we need to explore a plan that adds headroom but keeps the unit economics sensible. Can you propose a tranche-add that can be staged over 60 days with a clear rollback path if the personalization doesn't ramp? Also include any options to convert some burst hours to a committed pool.

If useful, loop in your engineering contact and we can do a short tech review next week.

—Maria
Maria Alvarez
Director, Platform Engineering
Cortexa Systems
maria@cortexa.com

Attachment: cortexa_usage_30d_export.csv (CSV, 120KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, connor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Cortexa Dedicated renewal — capacity forecast & burst playbook

Folks — forwarding Maria's note. Ben, can you validate availability and propose a staged tranche-add plan? Things to consider:
- Keep an initial +20% reserved tranche for 30 days (fast on, fast off). If metrics show >40% sustained uplift at 14-day check, escalate to +50% reserve with 30-day notice.
- Recommend using the 1.5x burst bucket for short marketing spikes to avoid committing immediately.
- Quantization profile: run `q4_0` on embeddings pipeline and keep `q8_0` for chat to preserve latency. Ops needs to confirm kernel choices for longer sequence lengths.

Also, include estimated monthly cost delta for each step and a simple clause for converting confirmed burst utilization into a commit at a pre-agreed rate. Connor, please share this proposal back to Maria and include a MAP so legal/procurement can stage sign-offs.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cortexa Dedicated renewal — capacity forecast & burst playbook

Maria —

Thanks for the detail and the export. We've reviewed it and sketched a phased MAP that balances runway and cost:

Phase 1 (0–30 days):
- Add a +20% reserved tranche (immediate) to cover the recent uplift and give time to observe personalization launch.
- Enable 1.5x burst pool with a 12-hour auto-scale window for marketing spikes — billable by burst-hour.
- Ops runbook: Ben will validate kernel/quantization choices and confirm KV-cache headroom by EOD Friday.

Phase 2 (day 31–60):
- If 14-day sustained uplift >40% on 14d rolling median, convert +20% reserved tranche to +50% reserved (30-day notice).
- Option to convert up to 40% of cumulative burst hours into commit at a discounted unit price (terms in MAP).

Next steps:
- I've attached our MAP (mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf) and the sizing workbook we discussed. Please confirm you can sign the MAP for the Phase 1 tranche so we can schedule the pool increase. Once you sign, Ben will run the kernel/quantization validation and we will provide the final cost table.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope?envelopeId=ABC-123-CX-2027
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCortexaRenewal

If you'd like a quick 20-min technical deep-dive with Ben and your eng-ops team tomorrow morning, we can book it now.

Best,
Connor

connor@redwoodinference.com
